# Your reading map {.unnumbered .unlisted}

**The valuation ideas behind the machine**

Start with the links below. Then read the full text at your own pace.

- **[Chapter 1 / Story and the 3P test](#r2-story)** - Separate price, value, and plausible assumptions.
- **[Chapter 2 / The base year](#r2-accounting)** - Know where the starting numbers come from.
- **[Chapter 3 / The nine-station DCF](#r2-dcf)** - Follow Almarai from revenue to value per share.
- **[Chapter 4 / Discount rates](#r2-rates)** - Match risk, currency, and dated inputs.
- **[Chapter 5 / Growth and terminal value](#r2-growth)** - Understand reinvestment, defaults, and ranges.
- **[Chapter 6 / What the market prices in](#r2-pricing)** - Keep pricing and valuation distinct.
- **[Chapter 7 / India and the checklist](#r2-india)** - See which inputs change across countries.

**Keep for later.** Read a chapter at a time. Its highlighted closing takeaways are your checkpoint; source lists and switch details are references.

## The four labels {.unnumbered .unlisted}

| Label | How to use it |
|---|---|
| [**READ FIRST**]{.legend-blue} | Blue. Essential to understanding the project or a decision. |
| [**KEY IDEA**]{.legend-teal} | Teal. A concept or checkpoint to remember; yellow marks short phrases. |
| [**WATCH OUT**]{.legend-orange} | Orange. A limitation, assumption, or common mistake to read carefully. |
| [**OPTIONAL - FIRST PASS**]{.legend-purple} | Purple. Return when you need this detail; the text is still here. |

*Reading labels are added guidance. The original text, figures, dates, and source references are retained. Page numbers in this edition may differ from the originals.*
